<style>
.agenda-root{display:grid;gap:12px}
.agenda-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.agenda-nav,.agenda-filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.agenda-title{font-family:var(--pda-display);font-size:22px;color:var(--pda-ink)}
.agenda-week{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;border:1px solid var(--pda-line,#ddd);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--pda-line,#ddd)}
.agenda-weekday{padding:8px;text-align:center;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;background:#eef3f1;color:#526b70}
.agenda-day{min-height:118px;padding:7px;background:#fffdfa;display:grid;align-content:start;gap:4px;cursor:pointer}
.agenda-day.outside{background:#f3f1ec;color:#9aa29f}
.agenda-day.today{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0f7a84}
.agenda-day-number{font-size:9px;font-weight:850}
.agenda-events{display:grid;gap:3px}
.agenda-chip{display:block;width:100%;overflow:hidden;padding:4px 5px;border:0;border-radius:6px;text-align:left;font-size:7px;line-height:1.2;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#163f49;background:#e3f0ef}
.agenda-chip[data-type*="FERIADO"],.agenda-chip[data-type="RECESSO_FURG"]{background:#f7e9df;color:#8c4c37}
.agenda-chip[data-type="PRAZO_TAREFA"]{background:#fff1cf;color:#7e5b13}
.agenda-chip[data-type="SAIDA_CAMPO"]{background:#e2ecf5;color:#255b78}
.agenda-list{display:grid;gap:6px}
.agenda-list-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #dde2dd;border-radius:9px;background:#fff}
.agenda-list-item strong{font-size:9px}.agenda-list-item small{font-size:7.5px;color:#71807d}
.agenda-list-item.has-origin{cursor:pointer}
.agenda-list-item.has-origin:hover{border-color:#8fbab5;background:#fbfdfc}
.agenda-list-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}
.agenda-origin-btn{min-height:28px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #b9cfca;border-radius:7px;background:#f0f7f5;color:#155b65;font-size:7px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.agenda-modal{width:min(680px,94vw);border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:0;box-shadow:0 22px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.agenda-modal::backdrop{background:rgba(4,30,42,.48)}
.agenda-form{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:16px}
.agenda-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.agenda-grid label,.agenda-form>label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:8px;font-weight:750}
.agenda-grid input,.agenda-grid select,.agenda-form input,.agenda-form select{width:100%;min-height:36px}
.agenda-form-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .agenda-week{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .agenda-weekday{display:none}
 .agenda-day{min-height:72px}
 .agenda-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .agenda-list-item{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.AGENDA=async ctx=>{
 const {el,button,call,status,richEditor}=App;
 const root=ctx.root;
 let cursor=new Date();
 cursor=new Date(cursor.getFullYear(),cursor.getMonth(),1);
 let filter='TODOS';

 const header=el('div',undefined,'agenda-toolbar');
 const nav=el('div',undefined,'agenda-nav');
 const prev=button('‹',()=>{cursor=new Date(cursor.getFullYear(),cursor.getMonth()-1,1);render();},true);
 const today=button('Hoje',()=>{const n=new Date();cursor=new Date(n.getFullYear(),n.getMonth(),1);render();},true);
 const next=button('›',()=>{cursor=new Date(cursor.getFullYear(),cursor.getMonth()+1,1);render();},true);
 const title=el('strong','', 'agenda-title');
 nav.append(prev,today,next,title);

 const tools=el('div',undefined,'agenda-filters');
 const select=el('select');
 [['TODOS','Todos'],['COMPROMISSO','Compromissos'],['AUDIENCIA','Audiências'],['SAIDA_CAMPO','Saídas de campo'],['PRAZO_TAREFA','Prazos'],['FURG','Calendário FURG'],['FERIADO','Feriados']].forEach(([v,l])=>select.append(new Option(l,v)));
 select.onchange=()=>{filter=select.value;render();};
 const add=button('+ Novo evento',()=>openForm(),false);
 tools.append(select,add);
 header.append(nav,tools);

 const calendar=el('div');
 const upcoming=el('div',undefined,'agenda-list');
 root.append(header,calendar,el('h3','Próximos compromissos'),upcoming);

 const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
 const dateKey=d=>d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate());
 const fmtDate=v=>{
   const d=new Date(v);return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())?String(v||''):d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'});
 };
 const fmtTime=v=>{
   const d=new Date(v);return Number.isNaN(d.getTime())?'':d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
 };

 async function openTaskOrigin(e){
   const task=e.tarefa&&e.tarefa.id
     ?e.tarefa
     :{
       id:e.tarefaId,
       titulo:e.titulo||'Prazo de tarefa',
       descricao:e.descricao||'',
       pessoaId:e.pessoaId||'',
       processoId:e.processoId||'',
       tipo:e.tarefaTipo||'TAREFA_GERAL',
       prazo:e.inicio||''
     };
   App.state.selection={task,historico:false};
   await App.go('TAREFAS');
 }

 async function openProcessOrigin(e){
   if(!e.processoId)return;
   App.state.selection={processoId:e.processoId};
   await App.go('PROC');
 }

 async function openOrigin(e){
   if(e.tarefaId)return openTaskOrigin(e);
   if(e.processoId)return openProcessOrigin(e);
   if(e.pessoaId){
     App.state.selection=e.pessoaId;
     return App.go('ACOMP',e.pessoaId);
   }
 }

 function matches(e){
   if(filter==='TODOS')return true;
   if(filter==='FERIADO')return String(e.tipo||'').includes('FERIADO')||e.tipo==='RECESSO_FURG'||e.tipo==='PONTO_FACULTATIVO';
   if(filter==='FURG')return String(e.tipo||'').includes('FURG');
   return e.tipo===filter;
 }

 function openForm(seedDate,event){
   const dialog=el('dialog',undefined,'agenda-modal');
   const form=el('form',undefined,'agenda-form');
   const heading=el('h3',event?'Editar evento':'Novo evento');
   const grid=el('div',undefined,'agenda-grid');
   const field=(label,node)=>{const w=el('label');w.append(el('span',label),node);return w;};
   const input=(type,value='')=>{const n=el('input');n.type=type;n.value=value||'';return n;};
   const t=input('text',event?.titulo||'');t.required=true;t.placeholder='Título';
   const type=el('select');
   [['COMPROMISSO','Compromisso'],['AUDIENCIA','Audiência'],['REUNIAO','Reunião'],['SAIDA_CAMPO','Saída de campo'],['FURG','Calendário FURG'],['FERIADO_FURG','Feriado/suspensão FURG'],['RECESSO_FURG','Recesso FURG']].forEach(([v,l])=>type.append(new Option(l,v)));
   type.value=event?.tipo||'COMPROMISSO';
   const start=input('datetime-local');
   const base=event?.inicio?new Date(event.inicio):new Date((seedDate||dateKey(new Date()))+'T09:00:00');
   start.value=base.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(base.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(base.getDate())+'T'+pad(base.getHours())+':'+pad(base.getMinutes());
   const end=input('datetime-local');
   if(event?.fim){const d=new Date(event.fim);end.value=d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())+'T'+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes());}
   const local=input('text',event?.local||'');
   const vis=el('select');[['PESSOAL','Pessoal'],['EQUIPE','Equipe'],['INSTITUCIONAL','Institucional']].forEach(([v,l])=>vis.append(new Option(l,v)));vis.value=event?.visibilidade||'EQUIPE';
   grid.append(field('Título',t),field('Tipo',type),field('Início',start),field('Fim',end),field('Local',local),field('Visibilidade',vis));
   const editor=richEditor(event?.descricao||'','Descrição, orientações e informações importantes');
   const actions=el('div',undefined,'agenda-form-actions');
   const cancel=button('Cancelar',()=>dialog.close(),true);
   const save=el('button','Salvar evento');save.type='submit';
   actions.append(cancel,save);
   if(event&&!event.sintetico){
     const del=button('Excluir',async()=>{if(!confirm('Excluir este evento?'))return;await call('agendaExcluir',{id:event.id},true);dialog.close();status('Evento removido.');render();},true);
     actions.prepend(del);
   }
   form.append(heading,grid,el('span','Descrição','hint'),editor.root,actions);
   form.onsubmit=async ev=>{
     ev.preventDefault();save.disabled=true;
     try{
       await call('agendaSalvar',{id:event?.sintetico?'':event?.id||'',titulo:t.value,tipo:type.value,inicio:new Date(start.value).toISOString(),fim:end.value?new Date(end.value).toISOString():'',local:local.value,visibilidade:vis.value,descricao:editor.getHtml()},true);
       dialog.close();status('Evento salvo.');await render();
     }finally{save.disabled=false;}
   };
   dialog.append(form);document.body.append(dialog);dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>dialog.remove(),{once:true});dialog.showModal();t.focus();
 }

 async function render(){
   title.textContent=cursor.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});
   const first=new Date(cursor.getFullYear(),cursor.getMonth(),1);
   const start=new Date(first);start.setDate(1-first.getDay());
   const end=new Date(start);end.setDate(start.getDate()+41);
   const data=await call('agenda',{de:dateKey(start),ate:dateKey(end)},false,{noLoader:true});
   if(!App.alive(ctx))return;
   const events=(data.eventos||[]).filter(matches);
   const byDate=new Map();
   events.forEach(e=>{const k=String(e.inicio||'').slice(0,10);if(!byDate.has(k))byDate.set(k,[]);byDate.get(k).push(e);});
   const week=el('div',undefined,'agenda-week');
   ['Dom','Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb'].forEach(v=>week.append(el('div',v,'agenda-weekday')));
   const todayKey=dateKey(new Date());
   for(let i=0;i<42;i++){
     const d=new Date(start);d.setDate(start.getDate()+i);const k=dateKey(d);
     const cell=el('div',undefined,'agenda-day'+(d.getMonth()!==cursor.getMonth()?' outside':'')+(k===todayKey?' today':''));
     cell.append(el('span',String(d.getDate()),'agenda-day-number'));
     const box=el('div',undefined,'agenda-events');
     (byDate.get(k)||[]).slice(0,5).forEach(e=>{
       const chip=el('button',e.titulo,'agenda-chip');chip.type='button';chip.dataset.type=e.tipo||'';
       if(e.tarefaId||e.processoId||e.pessoaId)chip.title='Abrir origem deste prazo';
       chip.onclick=ev=>{
         ev.stopPropagation();
         if(e.tarefaId||e.processoId){
           openOrigin(e).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));
           return;
         }
         e.sintetico?status(e.titulo+' · '+fmtDate(e.inicio)):openForm(k,e);
       };
       box.append(chip);
     });
     if((byDate.get(k)||[]).length>5)box.append(el('small','+'+((byDate.get(k)||[]).length-5)+' evento(s)','hint'));
     cell.append(box);cell.onclick=()=>openForm(k);week.append(cell);
   }
   calendar.replaceChildren(week);

   upcoming.replaceChildren();
   const nowKey=dateKey(new Date());
   const nextEvents=events.filter(e=>String(e.inicio||'').slice(0,10)>=nowKey).slice(0,12);
   if(!nextEvents.length)upcoming.append(el('p','Nenhum compromisso neste período.','hint'));
   nextEvents.forEach(e=>{
     const linked=!!(e.tarefaId||e.processoId);
     const row=el('div',undefined,'agenda-list-item'+(linked?' has-origin':''));
     const actions=el('div',undefined,'agenda-list-actions');
     if(e.tarefaId){
       const taskBtn=el('button','Abrir tarefa','agenda-origin-btn');taskBtn.type='button';
       taskBtn.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();openTaskOrigin(e).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));};
       actions.append(taskBtn);
     }
     if(e.processoId){
       const processBtn=el('button','Abrir processo','agenda-origin-btn');processBtn.type='button';
       processBtn.onclick=ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();openProcessOrigin(e).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));};
       actions.append(processBtn);
     }
     row.append(
       el('strong',fmtDate(e.inicio)+(e.diaInteiro?'':' · '+fmtTime(e.inicio))),
       el('div',(e.titulo||'')+(e.local?' · '+e.local:'')+(e.pessoa?' · '+e.pessoa:'')),
       el('small',String(e.tipo||'').replaceAll('_',' ')),
       actions
     );
     row.onclick=()=>{
       if(linked){openOrigin(e).catch(err=>status(err.message||String(err),true));return;}
       if(!e.sintetico)openForm(String(e.inicio).slice(0,10),e);
     };
     upcoming.append(row);
   });
 }
 await render();
};
</script>
